findings.quote: `HIL_NO_APPROVAL_ROUTE`; er läuft nie ungefragt [V: RH 1.4].
findings.problem: The whole native approval (E4, 3.5, 3.7) rests on a gate on the platform connector `gpos-price-gate`, used by a workflow tool node through `connector:`. The plan marks this [V]. But the 2.542.1 docs shipped with the CLI say twice that a connector gate is NOT enforced on a connector-bound workflow tool node, and that the node runs the tool without asking. Other docs and the feature catalog say the node fails or pauses. RH covers only the workflow `tools:` entry and rates the event path 'medium'. Worst case: `apply_price` sets the price with no human and no error, so the core message is false. The engine has no fail-closed guard. If Phase B fails, the plan falls back to Fläche D even though the documented gate on the workflow's own `tools:` entry (Phase A) could still work.
findings.evidence: review-sam/skills2542/sam-declarative-config/references/connector.md:144-146 "Workflow `type: tool` nodes that bind the connector run the tool without asking, so route a tool that needs approval through an agent node." design/agent-design.md:316-321: a connector gate on a workflow-bound tool "is parsed and validated but not enforced: a `type: tool` node dispatches the tool without asking". The same text is in the CLI binary (impl/hitl/sam-cli.strings:72526, 94700). The opposite view is in workflow.md:399-404 (fails) and STR:115366-115369 (pauses with both flags). RH 7 #4 rates the native pause for event runs 'medium'.
findings.fix:
3.7 ersetzen: „Ob ein Connector-Gate an einem Workflow-Tool-Knoten greift,
ist offen; die 2.542.1-Doku sagt teils ‚läuft ohne Rückfrage‘ [G0-02 B].“
G0-02 Phase B besteht nur, wenn die Engine `apply_price` zeitlich erst nach
der Inbox-Antwort empfängt (Zeitstempel im Engine-Log). Variante B2 spiken:
Gate am Workflow-`tools:`-Eintrag (`tool_type: mcp`, `/gate/mcp`, `hil`).
Fail-closed in `apply_price`: nur anwenden, wenn `approval/pending` mindestens
3 s zurückliegt; sonst Status `blocked`, Alarm auf `/op`, kein Preis.
Preflight: Kanarienlauf muss in der Inbox pausieren, sonst NOT READY.

findings.quote: Alle Rückgaben sind Pydantic-Modelle unter 2048 Byte (sonst
findings.problem: The size budget sits close to the threshold, and the plan never says what is measured. The MCP spec asks a tool with structuredContent to also return the serialized JSON as a TextContent. The result SAM sees is therefore about twice the model. Above the threshold SAM saves an artifact, and NO `mcp_structured_content` field resolves. TR1 (`writer_input` up to 1.2 KB) and TR5 (`agent_input` built from EligibleOffers up to 1,591 B) would fail at run time. Both are 'nie gestrichen'. G0-01 tests only an MCP stub. A connector-bound MCP tool cannot raise the threshold.
findings.evidence: Plan 3.9: "writer_input (<= 1,2 KB)". RL 6: "largest `EligibleOffers` 1,591 B compact (< 2048)". Memory sam-mcp-tools-in-workflows: over 2048 B "NO field of the response resolves"; BSG had to cut 2741 -> 1241 B; `tool_config` "is NOT available on a connector-backed MCP tool". RM 4.3: threshold 2048 B. AP07 acceptance: "jede Antwort < 2048 B" (basis undefined).
findings.fix:
AP07 und G0-01: Größe am vollständigen MCP-`CallToolResult` messen
(Text-Content plus `structuredContent`), Grenze 1800 B. `writer_input`
auf ≤ 600 B und `agent_input` auf Angebots-IDs plus Kurztexte kürzen.
G0-01 mit den Maximalfällen statt Stub: TR2 mit zwei Slots, Karte mit vier
Angeboten; Lauf muss alle Felder auflösen.

findings.quote: A2 Agent-Ziel `gpos-price-scout`, sonst A4 Preset
findings.problem: Fallback A2 uses the same unproven `artifactProcessing` transport, this time on an agent target. It also needs inline vision on artifacts attached by an event, which RM marks [S]. G0-05 tests inline vision only on a chat upload (S2). If S3 fails, A2 most likely fails too. A4 publishes a stored result, so no image is read at all. TR3 ('nie gestrichen') and owner requirement 3 (multimodal) would then be unmet. A path that does not depend on `artifactProcessing` is missing: S5 (MCP ImageContent) was dropped, and A3 (WebUI upload) appears only in 5.1.
findings.evidence: RM 1.2: "`enable_inline_vision` ... [V docs, S whether it also applies to artifacts attached by `artifactProcessing`]". RM 5 S2: "Agent (`fast`) in WebUI chat: upload PNG". RM 2.1 A3: "the Marktleitung tablet uses the SAM WebUI chat ... same agent". Plan 3.6: A4 "publiziert das gespeicherte Ergebnis des Requisits". 6.2: "Nie gestrichen: ... TR3 (Multimodal)".
findings.fix:

`artifactProcessing`, einmal mit `enableInlineVision`, einmal mit

auf `created_artifact`. Rückfallkette: A2 → S5 → A3 (Foto-Upload im

findings.quote: keine Inbox-Anfrage binnen 5 s erscheint
findings.problem: The L1h trigger and the reset step 'offene Anfragen abbrechen' (3.11.7) need the BFF to read and answer marktleitung's inbox, which takes a user token. In Fläche B (fallback when T6/T7 fail, and item 4 of the Streichliste) the BFF has no token. The only tokenless signal, `inboxCreated`, has an unknown payload and low confidence. In B, neither 'no request after 5 s' nor the cancellation can be detected or done. A visitor would wait until `hil.timeout` (2 min), which breaks 'ohne Hänger > 12 s'. Token model 2 ('SAM-Token aus einer morgendlichen Anmeldung') has no documented way for a BFF to get the browser's session token.
findings.evidence: RH 2.3: API keys are refused; a Keycloak bearer token is "UNVERIFIED" (RH 7 #12, low). RH 7 #22: `inboxCreated` usable "low (topic exists, payload unknown)". Plan 3.11.5: model 3 = Fläche B. 3.11.7: Reset "offene Anfragen abbrechen". 8.7: "ohne Hänger > 12 s".
findings.fix:
3.11 ergänzen: Die 5-s-Regel gilt nur in Fläche A. In Fläche B erkennt die
Engine L1h tokenfrei: über T13/T14, sonst spätestens 45 s nach
`approval/pending` ohne `applied` → Rückfall-Knopf auf `/freigabe` und
Monitor. G0-04 wertet T13/T14 als Kriterium für B. Reset in B: Vorschlag
`superseded`, `apply_price` antwortet `superseded`, SAM-Anfrage läuft nach
`hil.timeout` ab. Token-Modell 2 streichen oder Beschaffungsweg spiken.

findings.quote: Keycloak-Benutzer `marktleitung@solace.lab`, Gruppe `marktleitung`, SAM-Rolle `gpos_marktleitung`
findings.problem: R4 runs carry only an identity string and no OIDC token. Claim mappings grant roles from token claims. A marktleitung who never logged in, or one on a rebuilt AKS, may resolve to no role or to the default `sam_user` role, which lacks `workflow:*:invoke` and `notify:_:send`. R4 runs would then be denied. RH requires one login first (P2); the plan does not list that step. The lab RBAC uses only claim mappings.
findings.evidence: rbacClaimMapping.md: "grants a set of roles to every identity whose OIDC token carries a matching claim value". rbac-reference: "resolved roles are the union of YAML user-roles, IdP claim mappings, and database-managed assignments". RH 5.4 P2: "user logs in once to the WebUI". agent-mesh-deployment/scripts/rbac/README.md: default role `sam_user`.
findings.fix:
O2 ergänzen: `gpos_marktleitung` zusätzlich per `spec.users:
[marktleitung@solace.lab]` direkt zuweisen, `notify:_:send` für
`power_user` ebenso direkt. G0-02 P2 prüft einen R4-Lauf vor der ersten
Anmeldung von marktleitung; der AKS-Neuaufbau enthält diesen Schritt.

findings.problem: The phase table does not match the week plan. By G2 the week plan completes far more than the 53.5 PT that 7.2 allocates to G0-G2, so G2 (18.12.) cannot be met, while G3 and G4 are only partly loaded.

findings.quote: Hintergrundkassen, `PriceActionService` v0, REST/WS-Fassade, GEBIT-`ErrorMessage`, Probes | AP02, AP03 | 10 |

findings.quote: nach etwa 10 % Abstimmung und Lab-Störungen rund 97 PT netto [A]. Der Plan ist damit voll ausgelastet.
findings.problem: Muss (97.5 PT) already exceeds the stated net capacity (97 PT). The only reserve is 4 PT (about 4 %). The gross figure assumes no vacation or sick days outside Christmas, and the phase table plans against gross rather than net capacity.
findings.evidence: 11.11.2026 to 05.02.2027 is 63 weekdays (checked). Removing 25.12. and 01.01. (both Fridays) leaves 61 working days. 108 PT = 2 × 61 − 14 (holiday reduction), which means no sick or vacation days for two people over three winter months. Net capacity would be 14.4/18/18, so G0-G2 are overbooked by 3.1 PT before anything slips. DESIGN 13.4 kept about 6 % buffer (5.5/85) for a smaller scope. This plan depends on a controlled_availability flag and an Early Access notification service, which calls for a larger buffer, not a smaller one.

Krankheitsreserve) × 0,9 ≈ 94 PT netto. In 7.2 die Spalte
"Kapazität netto" ergänzen; je Phase gilt Muss ≤ netto. Zeile
Feiertage: "11 Arbeitstage (25.12. und 01.01. gesetzlich frei)".
Puffer auf mindestens 8 PT anheben und je Gate verteilen
(G1 2, G2 2, G3 2, G4 2).

Umschaltung auf 5G" ergänzen. Messe: am 14.02. Netztest (Kabel

findings.quote: | L3 Notbetrieb | AKS, Tunnel oder Uplink aus | Lab-MacBook mit vollem Stack, Router-DNS umgestellt | „Notbetrieb“ |
findings.problem: The L3 switch (3 minutes or less, via router DNS) assumes the lab serves the AKS hostnames, OIDC issuer and certificates. The lab is actually configured for *.solace.lab with the Lab-CA, and no work package covers this third configuration profile.
findings.evidence: 5.1: gpos.solace.lab, Keycloak auth.solace.lab, Lab-CA with Kyverno injection. 5.2: AKS uses *.<d> with LE certificates and 'keine Lab-CA auf iPads'. After a DNS switch, SAM's dnsName and OIDC redirect URIs, the Keycloak issuer and the BFF token client (token model 1) still use solace.lab names. Tablet login (Fläche B) and token use (Fläche A) therefore fail. The k8s overlays list only lab, aks and gebit-lab. AP14 (3.5 PT) also has to cover preflight, runbook, daily routine and exports. RA 6.2 step 9 includes the L3 switch inside 1.5 PT together with the VM and the peers. Lab Postgres state is separate from AKS PG.
findings.fix:
AP14b "L3-Profil" ergänzen (2 PT, Entwickler A): Overlay
k8s/overlays/l3 und SAM-Values l3 mit den AKS-Hostnamen (SAM dnsName,
Keycloak-Hostname und Issuer, Redirect-URIs, BFF-Keycloak-Client),
LE-Zertifikate per Skript aus AKS exportiert, Seed per install.sh db
identisch. Abnahme: L3-Drill am Stand-Router mit iPad ohne Profil,
TR1 mit Freigabe (Fläche A oder D) ≤ 3 min; je ein Drill in G3 und G4.

findings.quote: 450 POS-Läufe/h plus 30 Ketten/h (Trigger → Vorschlag → Freigabe, automatisch beantwortet) über 30 min
findings.problem: G0-08 (0.5 PT, developer B, due 20.11.) needs the full trigger, proposal and approval chain with automatic HITL answers. That chain exists only after AP08/AP09 (KW48-49) and after developer A's G0-02 and G0-04, which are due the same day. Yet the G0-08 result (R6: chain or workflow node) is supposed to decide how AP08 is designed.
findings.evidence: 7.1 sets G0-08 'Bis 20.11.' at 0.5 PT, and 7.3 assigns it to B in KW47, while G0-02 and G0-04 (A) end on the same day. Answering automatically needs the respond body (G0-02 T6) and the token model (G0-04 T7). load_gen.py does not exist yet. AP08 builds the real chain in KW48-49. 3.4 and R6 name 'workflow-Knoten statt Kette' as the alternative that G0-08 is meant to decide.

G0-08 teilen und vor AP08 entscheiden:
- G0-08a (B, bis 20.11., 0,5 PT): 450 Tool-Läufe/h mit dem
  Stub-Workflow aus G0-01, Flag an, Bursts von 7.
- G0-08b (A, bis 25.11., 1 PT): 30 Ketten/h aus Stub-Workflows mit

findings.quote: Rückfälle: A2 R2 zielt auf den Agent `gpos-price-scout`
findings.problem: Fallback A2 still brings the photo in through the same entrypoint artifactProcessing whose failure would trigger the fallback. If artifactProcessing fails, only A4 (preset, no live vision) is left, and owner constraint 3 (multimodal) is no longer met live. The independent path that G0-05 already tests (MCP ImageContent) is not used as a fallback.
findings.evidence: RM: from an event, an image reaches SAM 'only via artifactProcessing on the rule'. A2 keeps rule R2 and only changes the target to an agent, so it needs the same extraction. The G0-05 procedure includes 'MCP-`ImageContent`' (RM S5), but the G0-05 fallback column says only 'A2 Agent-Ziel gpos-price-scout, sonst A4 Preset'. The BFF already stores each photo in media.photo (3.12 step 2), so an MCP tool could supply it without artifactProcessing.
findings.fix:
Rückfall A2b vor A2 einfügen: gpos-competitor-price ohne
artifactProcessing; erster Knoten MCP-Tool load_photo(scan_id) liest
media.photo und gibt ImageContent zurück (G0-05 S5); danach
describe_image auf das erzeugte Artefakt oder Agent gpos-price-scout.
G0-05-Rückfallspalte: "A2b, sonst A2 (nur wenn S3 mit Agent-Ziel
grün), sonst A4 Preset". AP10 um 0,5 PT erhöhen.

findings.quote: Hinweis: Die Scratchpad-Berichte sind flüchtig; vor G0-Ende nach gebit-price-agent-demo/research/impl/ kopieren (Owner-Entscheidung).
findings.problem: All [V] evidence from RH, RM, RL, RA and RG, and the gRPC spike code that AP04 starts from in KW46, sit in a session-scoped /private/tmp scratchpad. Copying them is postponed to the end of G0 and left as an owner decision.
findings.evidence: Checked on 10.11.: /private/tmp/claude-501/.../scratchpad/impl/ holds research-{hitl,multimodal,loyalty-triggers,aks,grpc}.md plus grpc-spike/ (gebitsim/*.py, tools/*.py, out/, .venv 57 MB), loyalty-proto/, loyalty-sql/, mm/, hitl/ and aks/. 7.1 'Bereits erledigt [V]' (RG 18/18, RM 1.4, RL 6) and AP04 'Spike produktiv machen' in KW46 depend on these files. /private/tmp is not backed up and does not survive cleanup or reboot, and the known Rancher Desktop failure modes require Mac restarts.
findings.fix:
Am 11.11.2026 vor jeder Umsetzung kopieren: impl/research-*.md nach
research/impl/; Spike-Code (grpc-spike/gebitsim und tools ohne .venv
und out/, loyalty-proto, loyalty-sql, hitl, mm, aks) nach
gebit-price-agent-demo/spikes/. Keine GEBIT-Deskriptoren, -Protos
oder -Beispiele mitkopieren. Anhang C auf die neuen Pfade umstellen;
"Bereits erledigt [V]" erst danach so führen.

findings.quote: | 52–1 | 21.12.–06.01. | Testsätze TR3, Eval-Zeilen, `/freigabe`-Layout | UI-Layouts, Texte |
findings.problem: The G2 acceptance (18.12.) requires the TR3 test set, but the week plan creates the test sets only during the holidays after G2. The printed props the test set needs have no date and no owner.

The AP10 acceptance requires '≥ 28/30 Requisitenfotos korrekt erkannt; 0/20 Negativfotos'. 8.5 requires 30 photos of the props 'unter Messelicht' plus 20 negatives. 3.12 step 5 calls for a 'matt laminierter Prospekt'. präzisieren: "TR3-Testsatz ≥ 28/30 korrekt, 0/20 Negative mit

findings.quote: Apply und Deploy grün; je Regel ein Probe-Lauf in `tasks`; 0 Token in Läufen ohne Agent
findings.problem: Owner constraint 'Notifications' has no measurable acceptance in any work package and no failure drill. With fail_fast: true, a notify_user node that fails after apply_price turns a successful price change into a failed run, and record_outcome then logs it as a failure.
findings.evidence: Only the G0-03 spike measures notify_user; the AP08 and AP09 acceptances contain no notify_user check, although 6.2 lists Notifications as 'Nie gestrichen'. In 3.5, tell (notify_user) depends_on apply, the workflow runs with fail_fast: true, and on_exit.on_failure calls record with status '{{workflow.status}}'. engine.approval.outcome would therefore be 'failed' while the price is already active. RH 6 notes the notification service is Early Access. 8.7 has no 'Notification-Service aus' drill.
findings.fix:
AP08-Abnahme ergänzen: TR1, TR3 und TR5 je 10/10 genau eine
Notification in der Inbox von marktleitung ≤ 3 s, Titel im
Monitor-Ticker, höchstens drei je Besuch. record_outcome prüft vorher
engine.price_change: Preis aktiv → outcome "approved" mit error_code
"NOTIFY_FAILED" statt "failed". 8.7 um den Drill "notify_user
scheitert" ergänzen (10/10 Preis aktiv, Monitor korrekt).

findings.quote: SSE 30 min stabil mit automatischem Reconnect
findings.problem: The front-end acceptance covers 30 minutes, but the monitor, Kasse and tablet run unattended for about 9 hours a day on three fair days, in kiosk browsers over WireGuard. The 24-hour soak test exercises only backend load.
findings.evidence: This is the AP11 acceptance. In 8.6 the 24-hour AKS run uses load_gen.py with no browsers. 5.2 sets a 30-minute LB idle timeout and a 15-20 s SSE heartbeat. No test runs on the kiosk hardware, and the G4 rehearsals are short sessions.
findings.fix:
AP11-Abnahme ergänzen: /monitor, /kasse, /kunde und /freigabe laufen
10 h am Stück im Kiosk-Browser der Messe-Hardware über WireGuard
gegen AKS, parallel zum 24-h-Lauf in G3: 0 manuelle Reloads,
Browser-Speicher stabil (±20 %), Attract-Loop läuft.
